queries: Google March 2024 core update independent search quality study 45% reduction

sources_considered.why: Primary announcement with an April update reporting a quality improvement.
Independent practitioner measurements of search-result characteristics, with explicit methodological limitations.
Useful practitioner discussion, but not a controlled representative assessment of search quality.
Explains the intervention but does not independently measure the resulting quality change.

evidence_items.locator: Update April 26, 2024, under Reducing low-quality, unoriginal results
evidence_items.explanation: Google reports a substantial reduction, which challenges an absolute claim that nothing improved. Its stated comparison combines the update with earlier efforts and does not independently isolate the March update's effect.

The analysis compares result characteristics before and during the rollout and finds measurable changes. Word count and ranking movement do not establish whether users received meaningfully better results.

unresolved_gaps: The statement does not supply a determinate probability, quality threshold or observation period.
The sources examined do not provide a representative independent quality estimate attributable solely to the March core update.
